arabic text: APNE ROZE PE HUMKO BULALIJIYE, YA IMAM-E RAZA
english translation text: O IMAM RAZA! PLEASE CALL US TO YOUR SHRINE

arabic text: APNE ROZE PE HUMKO BULALIJIYE, YA IMAM-E RAZA\nYU MERA DARDE DILKI DAWA DIJIYE, YA IMAM-E RAZA
english translation text: O IMAM RAZA, PLEASE CALL US TO YOUR SHRINE\nO IMAM RAZA, PLEASE GIVE ME A CURE FOR THE PAIN IN MY HEART

arabic text: MUJKO IZNE HUZOORI HO PEHLE KARAM\nMERI KISMAT ME HO, ROSHNI YE HARAM\nMERA SOYA MUKADAR, JAGA DIJIYE, YA IMAM-E RAZA
english translation text: PLEASE GIVE ME THE PERMISSION TO ENTER YOUR HOLY SHRINE\nMAY I SEE THE LIGHT OF THE HARAM (SHRINE) WITH MY EYES\nPLEASE HELP TO BRIGHTEN MY DESTINY

arabic text: MERA AKA YE HAI ZINDAGI MUKHTASAR\nKHATME HONE KI HAI ZINDAGI KA SAFAR\nMUJ GHUNEGAR KO BAKSHA WA DIJIYE, YA IMAM-E RAZA
english translation text: OH MY IMAM, THIS LIFE IS VERY SHORT\nTHIS JOURNEY OF LIFE WILL COME TO AN END VERY SOON\nPLEASE HELP ME TO BE FORGIVEN BY ALLAH

arabic text: SHAHE LAULAAP KA WASTAA APKO\nPANJATAN PAAK KA WASTA APKO\nJO HAI BIMAR UNKO SHAFAA DIJIYE, YA IMAM-E RAZA
english translation text: I ASK YOU IN THE NAME OF RASULALLAH (SAW)\nI ASK YOU IN THE NAME OF THE AHULBAYT (A.S)\nPLEASE CURE ALL THOSE WHO ARE ILL
